newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals prices up sharply on global trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals prices up sharply on global trends.

text.p: Indian nickel prices gained sharply on Monday on the back of thin supplies, shortage of ready stock and speculative buying following rising global trends, dealers said.
Copper was weak while other base metals remained steady in a narrow trading range, they said.
Nickel gained by 300 rupees to 38,500 rupees per quintal.

Copper fell by 50 rupees to 12,650 rupees on sluggish physical demand. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,450 rupees, zinc at 6,300 rupees and lead at 4,850 rupees in narrow trade. Tin was quiet at 35,600. It was down by 400 rupees on Friday.
